data.name: I Have A Shit Problem
data.detailed_description:
I Have a Shit Problem

You need to find a toilet. Fast.

The first player to reach it becomes the Hunter. Everyone else disappears and must desperately avoid being found while their shit meter keeps rising.

Hide. Run. Leave suspicious traces. Watch for movement.

And whatever you do—

DON'T SHIT YOURSELF.

Features

  • Multiplayer chaos — Play with your friends and see who can survive the longest.

  • Hide & Seek — The Hunter can't see you, but moving players briefly reveal their silhouettes.

  • Shit Pressure — Holding it in isn't an option forever. Eventually, something has to come out.

  • Track & Reveal — Hunt down invisible players using silhouettes, traces, and your trusty toilet weapon.

  • Round-based gameplay — Each round starts with a race for the toilet and ends when the hidden players have been found or eliminated.

  • Very serious toilet-related gameplay.

Find the toilet.

Become the Hunter.

Try not to shit yourself.
